enabled.description: Denotes whether the Simple Network Management Protocol of an ATA is enabled.

trustedIP.description: Trusted IPv4 address and subnet mask in this order: 0.0.0.0/0.0.0.0.

getCommunity.description: Read-only community string that allows/denies access to other device's statistics. Default value is `public`.

setCommunity.description: Read-write community string that protects the device against unauthorized changes. Must never be set to `public`.

snmpV3Enabled.description: Denotes whether the SNMPv3 security is enabled.
